purpose: A-F EUDR readiness diagnostic across six dimensions: scope mapping, geolocation data quality, DDS submission readiness (TRACES NT), country risk assessment, risk mitigation documentation, and 5-year retention system. Returns readiness_grade (A-F), readiness_score (0-100), gaps list, and dual enforcement deadlines (large/medium 2026-12-30; micro/SME 2027-06-30). Terminal node of the eudr-supply-chain-risk-and-traceability chain. Zero network, zero PII. Reg. EU 2023/1115.
